justification: Restores a served DA-mode check (proposed vs LEP limit) and SEE standards rows

falsifiable_check.fails_when: lepLimits stops reading capacity.maxHeight / capacity.maxFSR, or a reader goes back to the missing height_limit field
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main /api/capacity/calculate/route.ts returns capacity.maxHeight/maxFSR (lines ~158-166) and ProvisionsByTocStructure.tsx passes lepClauseData?.height_limit / ?.fsr (both undefined) to DAModeCard, whose strip renders only when (lepHeight || lepFsr): DA mode shows no limits and no proposed inputs. lepLimits test 'reads the capacity shape' fails on main (module absent).

pre_impl.existing_data: the /api/capacity/calculate response stored as lepClauseData by usePropertyAssessment
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: a zero or missing limit is read as undefined, so no limit row is shown rather than a 0 m limit
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: every DA mode session and SEE export after this deploy

functions.name: lepLimits
functions.input: lepClauseData object from the capacity route held in page state
functions.output: height and FSR numbers for DA mode and the SEE builders
functions.if_none: null data or zero values return undefined for both, never 0

values.guard_at: num() returns undefined unless finite and above zero
values.if_missing: DA mode hides the height row as before

break_it.what_happens: DA mode silently loses its height check once more
break_it.how: one accessor with a test on the route's shape

break_it.scenario: limit arrives as a string like '8.5'
break_it.what_happens: a string limit would not compare numerically against the proposed height

break_it.scenario: lot has no FSR control (e.g. Camden R2)
break_it.what_happens: a 0 FSR would make every proposal fail the check
break_it.how: zero or null gives undefined so no FSR row is shown

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — DA mode on 6 Berrigan St shows Height limit 9 m and FSR 0.5:1 with proposed inputs
